changes.detail: Each entry point was bundled with its own copy of the package's shared code, so an error thrown by one entry point (GitIngestionError from @absolutejs/git/github-app, say) was never instanceof the class exported by another (@absolutejs/git). Consumers' error handling missed every such error. The build now splits shared code into one chunk.
changes.summary: Errors are the same class whichever entry point threw them

changes.detail: listGitHubBranchRules reads the rules every active ruleset applies to a branch, which need not exist yet, with Metadata read only. getGitHubRepositoryMergeSettings reads which merge methods a repository allows, null where GitHub hides a field.
changes.summary: Read what a repository's GitHub settings allow

changes.detail: markGitHubPullRequestReady marks a draft pull request ready for review through GraphQL's markPullRequestReadyForReview (REST can't change a pull request's draft state), with the pull request's new nodeId; GraphQL errors are thrown with GitHub's message.
changes.summary: Mark a draft pull request ready for review

changes.detail: createGitHubAppInstallationToken takes permissions, so a write is asked for only by the call that writes; getGitHubAppInstallation and listGitHubAppInstallationsForUser report the permissions an installation has accepted; findGitHubPullRequest, getGitHubPullRequest, createGitHubPullRequest, updateGitHubPullRequest and mergeGitHubPullRequest manage a branch's pull request, and a merge goes through GitHub, so the repository's branch protection and required checks decide (GitHubMergeRefusedError on 405 or 409).
changes.summary: Send work to GitHub: scoped write tokens and pull requests

changes.detail: GitHubAppInstallation gains permissions, what the installation has accepted (an App's new permissions reach an installation only once its owner accepts them). createGitHubAppInstallationToken takes an optional permissions to narrow the token; without it nothing changes.
changes.summary: Installations report their accepted permissions; tokens can be narrowed

changes.detail: verifyGitHubAppCheckSuiteWebhook reads a signed check_suite completed event; listGitHubCommitCheckRuns lists a commit's latest check runs across every page with the App that owns each; gitHubChecksVerdict says whether they are none, pending, passed or failed, leaving out runs a deployer posts itself.
changes.summary: Gate a deploy on a commit's GitHub checks
